title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 10 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错

sentences.en: A police officer keeps us safe.
A driver takes us to school.
A cleaner makes the street clean.
Because he has a lot of boxes.
